review:
Arrow is a retrowave 3x3 slot with an unusual layout and a spinning arrow. When the scatter appears at the arrow's tip, it starts the Wheel of Fortune bonus, which stops on a random prize boosted by any multipliers in play.

Respin multipliers add extra wins in the base game. Chance x2 raises the bet by 1.2x and doubles the odds of landing a respin multiplier or the wheel bonus, and a bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 3,600x maximum, and the RTP is an outstanding 97.33%. The bonus is very frequent, roughly once every 20 spins on average, so sessions are lively.
pros: Excellent 97.33% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 20 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
